entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello? I... I need some help with a return. I'm just so disappointed.
Hi there, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. I can definitely look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... VF78-21-B. It's about the ProFit jersey I ordered.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now... Okay, I see the ProFit jersey, delivered on January 12th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's the wrong size. I followed the chart, but it's just so terribly tight. I can barely breathe in it. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I was so excited for this. Now I'm just... sad. I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work.

I'm very sorry to hear that the jersey didn't fit as expected. I know how disappointing it is when you're looking forward to new gear. Would you be interested in an exchange for a larger size, or would you prefer to proceed with a return for a refund?
I think I'd just like to return it. After this, I'm not sure what size to even try. I just want to send it back.
I understand completely. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, thanks for holding, Sarah. I've checked our policy, and since your jersey was delivered within the last 10 days, you are absolutely eligible for a full refund. I can process that for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful. Thank you so much. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. That's a huge relief.

Not a problem at all. I'm glad we could get this sorted out for you. I've just emailed a prepaid return shipping label to you. Just pack the item up, attach the label, and you can drop it off at the post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive it. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful, Isaac. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
